secondaryHeights.method: Coarse width-to-height proportions and number of visible eaves/levels in official street photos, using OSM width as contextual bound. Cropping/occlusion and perspective prevent calibrated photogrammetry. Broad candidate values, not pixel-derived survey.
secondaryHeights.uncertainty: ±6–7m planning allowance; not a statistical confidence interval; exact roof finial and ground datum unknown

roofProfiles.method: Visible stacked eaves, upturned corners and hipped-gabled roof rhythm simplified into curved surfaces. Ratios reproduce silhouette without asserting joinery survey.
roofProfiles.uncertainty: height fractions ±.06; plan factors ±.10; corner lift ±.8m; rear roof evidence incomplete

facade.method: Visible yellow end walls, red pillars/doors, pale stone bases, green windows, gold plaque frames. Simplified repeated mesh detail; exact traditional components unknown.
facade.uncertainty: body inset ±.05, door fraction ±.06, pillar radius ±.10m, plinth ±.5m; plaque lettering pending

baseYContract.meaning: absolute game-unit bottom of the frozen .5m plinth; threshold is baseY+.5*.60

baseYContract.sourceBasis: caller-owned external input; no automatic DSM floor assignment

kings.method: Small source-registered hall-front apron. Photo-visible masonry plinth/stone balustrades and human-scale context guide a simplified local drop; no calibrated photogrammetry. Width uses .96 of the OSM roof width only as a modelling constraint; front length deliberately limited to avoid invented whole courtyards. Steps are generated from drop/max-riser, not counted in a survey.

uncertainty.boundsMeaning: broad modelling allowances, not guaranteed/statistical confidence

kings.joiningStatus: pending surveyed floors/current terrain cut and external path validation

ridgeEnds.method: Representative pale ceramic upward curl silhouettes supplement old ridge caps; source roof detail hall attribution unknown. Not dragon/chifinial carving reproduction.
